entities.name: Horn Monument
entities.description: Twin horn-shaped pillars flanking key landmarks on Amonkhet, built by Bolas as symbols of his dominance; ruined after the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Landmark flanked by the Horn Monument, erected by Bolas in his visage.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who erected the Horn Monument and Throne.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: Sun the horns were built to frame on the horizon.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: Event after which the monument was damaged.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: War after which the monument was left ruined.

events.summary: After the Final Hours and the War of the Spark, the Horn Monument is left damaged and ruined.
events.quote: the Horn Monument was left damaged and ruined.

relations.quote: erected by Bolas in his visage
